structured_output.analysis: The budget is fully used: 84617/26880 works out to the 3.148 average bits of iso_3.15 (KL 0.43614, E514ab09c524e). Upgrading any layer needs an equal-sized downgrade elsewhere. None of the retrieved layers is a clearly cheap downgrade target, and I can't see the bit cost of the other layers, so a paired swap would risk being refused for going over budget. The largest measured single-layer losses are all MLP projections at 3 or 2 bits. Examples: model.layers.14.mlp.down_proj with rht_gptq_int2 at 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065) against 0.00181 with rht_gptq_int3 (E90bd4b2f3645), and model.layers.27.mlp.up_proj with gptq_int3 at 0.00572 (Ef04d8aa7bded) against 0.00217 with gptq_int4 (Efea8c18d2abc). Every layer already uses the best measured method at its bit width, so a same-width method swap gains nothing. The changes that cost no bits are GPTQ solver options: act_order and damp don't change the stored bits. This round therefore tests act_order=true and damp=0.005 across the GPTQ-family methods, which make up 179 of 196 layers. The aim is to lower the 3-bit and 2-bit errors without spending budget.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder
proposals.rationale: Uses the same bits as iso_3.15 (KL 0.43614, E514ab09c524e) and turns on act_order=true for all GPTQ-family methods. The loss sits in 3-bit and 2-bit GPTQ MLP layers: 14.down_proj with rht_gptq_int2 at 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065) and 27.up_proj with gptq_int3 at 0.00572 (Ef04d8aa7bded). 27.up_proj also has activation kurtosis 1090.09 (E24beed188b6a), where ordering columns by activation importance should help most.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_actorder_damp005
proposals.rationale: Costs no bits relative to iso_3.15 (KL 0.43614, E514ab09c524e). Sets act_order=true and damp=0.005 (lower than the default 0.01) so the Hessian correction matters more in the low-bit layers. Examples: 3.up_proj with rht_gptq_int3 at 0.00642 (E6f4f7ea296d5) and 18.gate_proj with rht_gptq_int2 at 0.00497 above floor (Eb1dd74cd6447).

proposals.name: iso_3.15_damp005
proposals.rationale: Costs no bits relative to iso_3.15 (KL 0.43614, E514ab09c524e). Changes only damp=0.005, so its effect can be separated from act_order. The target is the GPTQ-dominated loss, such as 1.up_proj with rht_gptq_int3 at 0.00611 (E0564bc6ad1eb) and 27.gate_proj with rht_gptq_int3 at 0.00499 (Efa0bb391da67).
